title: Crispy Mexican Sweet Potato Hash
description: A keto twist on a classic breakfast dish, this sweet potato hash is crispy, flavorful, and perfect for a morning meal.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the diced sweet potatoes with 1 tsp of mexican seasoning and spread out on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook the crispy bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the pan and set aside.
Add the crumbled bacon back into the pan and stir in chopped cilantro.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, toss them with the bacon mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
